# Ray2Volt Solar Private Limited

> Rooftop solar EPC for homes, businesses and industry in Tirupati, Srikalahasti and across Andhra Pradesh, India. Ray2Volt designs, installs and services on-grid and hybrid solar plants, handles PM Surya Ghar subsidy and APSPDCL net-metering paperwork, and builds commercial and industrial rooftop systems under both CAPEX and RESCO models.
